newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says U.S. Feb car sales rose 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says U.S. Feb car sales rose 3 pct.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Monday its U.S. February car sales rose three percent to 6,651 vehicles from 6,454 in the same month a year earlier.
Thus far in the year the company's U.S. car sales have fallen somewhat to 16,133 from 16,163 in 1996, Volvo spokesman Ingmar Hesslefors told Reuters.
Hesslefors said he expected sales to be boosted through the launch of the S/V70 and S/V90 models at the beginning of April.
Volvo's Canadian car sales rose by 13 percent in February to 658, he said.
